g.text: starts a run, asks how it goes
the four routes and the run desk (8)
the player (3, 4), the runner (5), the judge
in the same program, asked over HTTP
the agent's model and the judge's
every answer of a live run (9)
the guide's recordings, for one test (10)
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The eval library is mapped by the site's own API program. A run asks the agent over the sessions API like any app, keeps its file in the data folder, and its
recordings are the engine's, in the replay folder. The number in brackets is the step.
